parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the Bastionhost instance.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to retrieve this parameter

堡垒机的实例ID。

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.
For the mappings between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host shared key.
This parameter is required. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462973.html operation to retrieve this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
主机共享密钥的ID。

此参数为必传参数。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462973.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_share_key_id

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
